message: Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times.
text:
Notes Improver is confirmed and running. Its first run is at 00:00 tomorrow on the host clock, since you haven't given me a time zone. The prediction is published and will be judged 7 days after its first run.

**Expected effects recorded first:**
- Notes files rise. This is on the `notes_files` stock, which is linked to `repo_files`.
- The commit rate goes up 1.2 times. The model has no flow that counts commits (`repo_commits` is only a measured input), so I put the factor on the flow of landed merges into `repo_files`. That is the closest proxy, and it is not a true commit count. Say if you want it measured differently.

**Before the first run:**
- Time zone: what time zone is 00:00 in? I'll set it once you tell me.
- Two event types it listens for, `gate.rejected` and `changes.requested`, have no publisher yet, so those triggers will never fire. The daily run still reads them, so it will see rejections only once something publishes them.
- Notes files are still counted through `repo_files`, which includes all tracked files, not just notes. Exact counting is still open. Say if you want the exact `notes/` count instead.
